name: G.U.S. Shieldwake

operational_identity.role_emphasis: Aggressive interception, independent patrol, pursuit disruption, exposed-craft escort, and rapid response beyond the flagship's immediate screen.
operational_identity.ship_character: The Shieldwake is associated with forward pressure, fast repositioning, and a willingness to operate at the edge of the task group's support envelope while preserving a defined route back to the protected formation.
operational_identity.formation_preference: Often used where an early intercept, independent investigation support, or distant recovery action can prevent a threat from reaching the Judicator group.

command_relationship.task_group_rule: Captain Alric Tann directs task-group operations; Captain Corin Hale retains internal command, discipline, readiness, safety, and damage-control authority aboard the Shieldwake.
command_relationship.hosted_asset_boundary: The Shieldwake may support Rangers, Marshals, Sentinels, diplomatic craft, and court-related movements without assuming their institutional mission authority.

placement_rule: No fixed coordinates. Position must be asserted per event with valid movement, formation, patrol, detachment, pursuit, recovery, or emergency-separation continuity.
specifications_note: Class-level canonical capabilities and staged technical envelope are defined by cls_vigilant. No vessel-specific dimensions, complement, armament, or performance have been promoted.
promotion_pass: Judicator Task Group Vessel Identity Pass — 2026-07-21
notes: Name and vessel ID are collision-free against CanonRec and AUo959/aurora-cloudbank-symbolic at admission.

derived_capabilities.basis: Extrapolated from the vessel's canonical class (cls_vigilant, Vigilant-Class) per the reconciliation principle: a vessel inherits its class's established role, features, and complement unless a vessel-specific source overrides.
derived_capabilities.class_role: General-purpose fleet escort, screening, interception, anti-piracy, picket duty, convoy protection, independent patrol, and rescue support.

identity_key_note: entity_id added 2026-08-09 (canon-identity-key-unification). mobile_asset records historically keyed identity as canonical_id while the other 166 canon records use entity_id, so any tool indexing only entity_id silently skipped every vessel. Both keys hold the same value; canonical_id is retained for back-compat with readers that depend on it (e.g. tools/character_capsule_adapter.py).
